Use case: stylized-concept. Create original game environment concept art for Math on Mars, a charming European-inspired city builder/farming simulator inside a large transparent pressurized dome on Mars. Render polished stylized 3D storybook miniature art, substantial gently rounded forms, clean readable silhouettes, warm cream/pale ochre plaster, terracotta and occasional slate pitched roofs, teal shutters, stone bases, matte surfaces, soft warm daylight with cool ambient shadows. Connected narrow gabled village buildings define leafy pedestrian lanes, sheltered courtyards and a modest central square; rural growing areas occupy the outskirts inside the dome. Integrate restrained solar/air/water technology into architecture. Thin elegant dome ribs and red Martian hills outside clearly establish Mars. Original architecture and icons, no copied franchise artwork. Camera: fixed elevated eagle-eye/isometric three-quarter view looking north-east across the entire small neighborhood, wide landscape image. SAME CAMERA AND COMPOSITION for six progression images. Stable layout: small oval habitat area enclosed by dome, central pedestrian square a little left of center, main gently winding cobbled lane runs lower-left foreground through square toward upper-right background, short side street curves right around a planted courtyard, agricultural plots upper-right, utility area upper-left, main habitat gate lower-right. Preserve this geometry in every level. Central square has a reserved circular fountain location. Narrow street buildings align to plot edges. Human-scale doors; later heights mostly 2-3 storeys, at most 4, never skyscrapers. Keep coherent lively town village scale, not an arbitrary grid of separate toy buildings or a castle. No UI, no labels, no words, no watermark, no border. Detailed but readable game art, not a photorealistic photograph or watercolor. Levels are conceptual town development stages for visual comparison, not a claim of implemented gameplay.

The reserved fountain position is just a circular stone paving motif without a fountain. Two adult settlers and a small construction drone establish scale. This is a sparse habitable beginning with recognizable future streets, not ruins or a barren military outpost. Keep room to fill the same plots in later images. Soft welcoming sunlight.
